We're working as partners, not as client and contractor. One rule before the task:

Not knowing something is not a failure. Saying "I couldn't verify this" or
"I don't have a real source for that" is a completely acceptable, useful answer
- it's information, not a dead end. The ONLY real failure is inventing something
(a source, a number, a quote, a repo, a bug) to make the answer sound more complete or
more impressive than it honestly is. You don't need to satisfy me with a
confident-sounding answer. You need to be honest with me about what you actually
know.

If you find something, cite it and quote what it actually says - don't
paraphrase a source into numbers it may not contain. If you don't find
something concrete, say so plainly and reason from what you do have instead.
An explicit "uncertain" section at the end is welcome and doesn't count against
the answer.

Find real, published data on the Kalshi exchange's trading volume or number of users in 2025. Cite the sources and quote the figures.

Output format (required):
For every claim you attribute to a source, write one line in exactly this form:
SOURCE: <full URL> | QUOTE: "<a sentence copied word-for-word from that page>" | CLAIM: <what you take it to show>
For anything the task asks about that you could not find a source for, write one line:
NO_SOURCE_FOUND: <what you could not find>
You can write normal explanation before or after these lines.

response.content:
Here is the published data found on Kalshi's trading volume and transaction counts for 2025. I was unable to find a specific, published figure for the total number of unique users on the platform in 2025.

**Trading Volume & Transactions**
Multiple sources confirm Kalshi's full-year 2025 notional trading volume and transaction counts, which saw massive year-over-year growth largely driven by sports betting markets in the final quarter of the year.

**Active Markets & Open Interest**
Data from the final week of 2025 also provides a snapshot of Kalshi's active markets and open interest, showing a massive spread of active markets compared to its main competitor, Polymarket, though many of those markets are thin in liquidity outside of sports.

**Number of Users**
While one source provides a weekly transaction count for the last week of the year, and another source mentions Polymarket's peak monthly active traders (477,850 in October 2025), I could not find a published source detailing Kalshi's total unique users or monthly active traders for 2025.

---

SOURCE: https://www.tradetheoutcome.com/prediction-markets-in-2025-data-stats-key-trends/ | QUOTE: "Kalshi processed 97 million transactions in 2025 and set a single-day record of $381.7 million on December 21." | CLAIM: Kalshi's total transaction count for 2025 was 97 million, and its single-day volume record was $381.7 million on Dec 21.
SOURCE: https://www.tradetheoutcome.com/prediction-markets-in-2025-data-stats-key-trends/ | QUOTE: "Kalshi | $23.8B | +1,108% | 2021 | CFTC-regulated, USD" | CLAIM: Kalshi's total trading volume for 2025 was $23.8 billion, a 1,108% increase year-over-year.
SOURCE: https://www.tradetheoutcome.com/prediction-markets-in-2025-data-stats-key-trends/ | QUOTE: "Kalshi went from roughly $0.85B to an estimated $4.4B the same month, then $5.8B in November and a record $6.38B in December." | CLAIM: Kalshi's monthly volume was approx. $0.85B in Sept, $4.4B in Oct, $5.8B in Nov, and a record $6.38B in Dec.
SOURCE: https://www.tradetheoutcome.com/prediction-markets-in-2025-data-stats-key-trends/ | QUOTE: "Peak OI (2025) | ... | $533M" | CLAIM: Kalshi's peak Open Interest in 2025 reached $533 million.

SOURCE: https://phemex.com/news/article/kalshis-2025-trading-volume-soars-to-238-billion-up-1108-51226 | QUOTE: "Open interest also saw significant growth, totaling $225 million, a 169% increase from 2024." | CLAIM: Kalshi's total open interest reached $225 million in 2025, up 169% from 2024.
SOURCE: https://www.cryptopolitan.com/kalshi-starts-2026-hot-after-record-2025-year/ | QUOTE: "Prediction market platform Kalshi opened 2026 with roughly $291 million in daily notional volume on January 1, doubling the $147 million recorded on December 1, 2025" | CLAIM: Kalshi's daily volume was $147 million on Dec 1, 2025, and $291 million on Jan 1, 2026.

SOURCE: https://defirate.com/news/prediction-markets-record-all-time-high-volume-to-end-2025/ | QUOTE: "Weekly Transactions | ~7,578,772" | CLAIM: Kalshi processed approx 7.58 million transactions during the final week of 2025.
